scenes.name: The first spirit freed
scenes.plays: the first spirit you free (then each realm's first spirit can reuse it)
scenes.story: A spirit chained to a bindstone toils without rest. You come close, see how the chains have worn it thin, lay your hand on the stone — your eyes burn rune-blue — and the chains burst. The spirit rises free; lines of light run out from under your feet into the land and the grass follows them; the spirit thanks you and drifts away over the hills to the village, where it waits on the Green, the first to come home.

scenes.name: The opening — the Long Quiet, the storm and the twins
scenes.plays: a new game (replaces the six opening panels)
scenes.story: The dead of Runeheim once rose along the World Tree and new souls came down it. Then the road went quiet: no child was born in the last village for twenty winters, and the Binders came for the dead. On the night of a terrible storm lightning struck the runestones, and at dawn a basket drifted out of Mirror Lake with two babes whose eyes glowed rune-blue. The village raised them; the stones woke for them. Sixteen winters on, one twin goes out into Runeheim and the other stays.

scenes.name: The celebration — children again
scenes.story: The village celebrates the twins on the Green under lanterns and the aurora. Time passes; the first newborn cries; Pip and Wren play with the twins; children play at being twins in every hamlet.

beats.title: The feast
beats.cap: The village celebrated the twins.
beats.m: long tables on the village green under lanterns, villagers raising cups to the twins Zeldor and Zeldara at the head of the table
beats.f: long tables on the village green under lanterns, villagers raising cups to the twins Zeldor and Zeldara at the head of the table

beats.title: Dancing
beats.cap: They danced till the stars came out.
beats.m: dancing round the carved runestone, Elder Runa with the twins Zeldor and Zeldara, music, an aurora above
beats.f: dancing round the carved runestone, Elder Runa with the twins Zeldor and Zeldara, music, an aurora above

beats.title: Playing twins

scenes.name: The credits — and after
scenes.story: The credits roll over the night lake under forty stars; the twins on a hill over a green Runeheim; then the road goes on.

beats.f: Mirror Lake at night reflecting an aurora, forty bright stars above, golden spires in the water

scenes.name: The World Tree under the lake
scenes.plays: all forty spirits free, after the end
scenes.story: After the end, the last spirit is freed. Its line races to join the others, and all forty draw one great World Tree across Runeheim. The tree's light flows into Mirror Lake and shines under the water like a tattoo — and stays.

beats.cap: The fortieth spirit, free.
beats.m: Zeldor by a bindstone in a green land as the last spirit rises free
beats.f: Zeldara by a bindstone in a green land as the last spirit rises free

beats.title: The last line

beats.f: its line of light racing across the land to join the others

beats.title: One tree

beats.f: from high above: all the lines of light across Runeheim joining into one great World Tree

beats.title: Into the lake

beats.f: the tree's light flowing down into Mirror Lake

beats.title: Under the water

beats.f: Mirror Lake from above at twilight, a vast World Tree of rune-blue and gold light glowing deep under its water

beats.f: small boats with lanterns drifting over the glowing tree
